Origin - On December 29th, 2014, Viner Lilianna Hogan posted a Vine clip taken during her vacation at the Volcanoes National Park in Rwanda, which begins with a panoramic view of the vista before panning over to her Rwandan tour guide who replies "okay" with a smile after she says "hi" in greeting.
